title: Founding Engineer
description: About Share Share is a venture-backed startup building the global marketplace for bandwidth. We enable anyone to build their own programmable internet network, in seconds. Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. Only the largest tech companies have escaped this, by spending billions to build their own physical networks. Share is giving that power to everyone. Infrastructure providers sell their services in the Share Marketplace; giving builders, AI agents and enterprises the ability to build their own global backbone via an API layer. The path, the performance, how long they need it and paying only for what they use. The role We are hiring a Founding Engineer to take ownership of core platform architecture as we rebuild for a system roughly 50x the scale of what we had before. You'll design and scale distributed systems from scratch (this is deep systems-architecture work, not feature development on an existing system.) You will work directly with the Head of Development and a small team of engineers to ship production systems operating at global scale. Non-negotiable 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with real, hands-on ownership of designing and scaling a production system from scratch. You can describe specific production incidents at scale (what broke, why, and what you changed) not just system-design-interview theory. Deep TypeScript/Node.js expertise. You should be able to design a NestJS microservice from scratch, not just work in one. Strong PostgreSQL skills. You can design schemas for complex, high-throughput production data, write migrations, and reason about transaction isolation and locking. Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar). You understand the difference between request-reply and fire-and-forget patterns and when to use each. You ship. You can take a spec document and turn it into production code without waiting for someone to break it into small tasks. Nice to have, not required : prior fintech/payments experience or blockchain/distributed-ledger exposure AI-augmented engineering (required mindset) We expect every engineer at Share to use AI tools as a daily part of their workflow. This is how we operate. Our entire project planning, specification, and documentation process runs through AI-assisted sessions. Our codebase includes AI-readable context files. We use Claude for architecture decisions, code review, spec generation, and technical writing. What this means for you: You already use AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) daily and can articulate how they change your workflow. You are comfortable working with AI-generated specifications and can critically evaluate them, push back where they are wrong, and extend them where they are incomplete. You see AI as a force multiplier that lets a small team operate at the capacity of a much larger one. You are not threatened by it; you are faster because of it. You are willing to contribute to improving our AI-assisted workflows Compensation & Details: Competitive Salary & Equity package Additional Benefits Paid Business Travel when needed Ownership in a venture-backed early stage startup building the future of physical and digital infrastructure in Africa Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AI Platform Engineer
description: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. The role We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it. You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built. Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are. Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on. AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products. Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear. What we look for A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction. Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it. High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through. Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so. Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore. Why join You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You will explore consumer behaviour, social conversations, creator activity, competitor performance and cultural trends, turning your findings into compelling stories and practical recommendations. This is an early-career opportunity suited to someone with one to two years of marketing, research, social media or insights experience who is curious about audiences, brands and culture.</p> <h3>Skills and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Insight Generation & Analysis:</li> <li>Conduct research into consumer behaviour, social media conversations, creator activity, competitor campaigns and emerging cultural trends.</li> <li>Review campaign results and relevant performance indicators to identify key themes, patterns and opportunities.</li> <li>Bring together information from multiple sources and translate findings into clear, engaging insight stories.</li> <li>Support the development of practical recommendations for campaign planning, creator strategy and content development.</li> <li>Use social listening, audience intelligence and research platforms to gather relevant information, with guidance from senior team members.</li> <li>Maintain a high standard of accuracy and attention to detail across all research and reporting.</li> </ul> <h3>Project & Stakeholder Management:</h3> <ul> <li>Support defined intelligence and insights projects, from initial research and influencer marketing, social platforms, creator culture and the wider media landscape.</li> <li>Develop confidence in research, insight generation and storytelling techniques through hands-on experience and team support.</li> <li>Stay informed about emerging platforms, consumer behaviours, cultural shifts and industry developments.</li> <li>Contribute ideas, examples and useful resources that support the team’s shared knowledge.</li> <li>Follow established research standards and best practices, including accurate sourcing and clear documentation.</li> </ul> <h2>Key Responsibilities:</h2> <h3>Intelligence & Research Operations:</h3> <ul> <li>Conduct desk research using reliable sources to support campaign briefs, pitches, reports and strategic projects.</li> <li>Monitor social conversations, creator activity, competitor behaviour and category developments to identify relevant insights.</li> <li>Help produce regular intelligence outputs, including trend to understand.</li> <li>Support the maintenance of campaign tracking documents, research libraries and shared intelligence resources.</li> <li>Ensure campaigns and relevant information are added promptly to internal platforms, following up with stakeholders when details are missing.</li> </ul> <h3>Insight Development & Quality:</h3> <ul> <li>Identify meaningful themes and patterns within research, social conversations and campaign information.</li> <li>Help turn observations into insights by explaining what is happening, why it matters and how brands could respond.</li> <li>Sense-check findings to ensure conclusions are supported by appropriate evidence.</li> <li>Check sources, calculations, formatting and written outputs carefully before sharing work.</li> <li>Ask thoughtful questions and seek guidance when information is incomplete, unclear or inconsistent.</li> </ul> <h3>Platform & Application Knowledge:</h3> <ul> <li>Develop working knowledge of our core intelligence, campaign and reporting applications, including Benchmark Index, Performance Analyser and Deliverables Calculator.</li> <li>Use social listening, audience intelligence and research tools to gather information and identify relevant trends.</li> <li>Confidently use Excel or Google Sheets for organising information, completing basic analysis and producing clear summaries.</li> <li>Navigate our BI and internal reporting tools to access existing information and dashboards, with training and support provided.</li> <li>Share feedback on internal tools and processes to help improve usability and team efficiency.</li> </ul> <h3>Collaboration & Development:</h3> <ul> <li>Work closely with colleagues across Intelligence and Insights, Strategy, Campaigns and other relevant teams.</li> <li>Communicate clearly and proactively to help ensure actions are completed and projects remain on track.</li> <li>Participate in team discussions and contribute a curious, audience-focused perspective.</li> <li>Build effective working relationships by being dependable, collaborative and open to feedback.</li> <li>Take ownership of personal development and actively build knowledge of the influencer marketing and social media landscape.</li> </ul> <h2>The Ideal Candidate:</h2> <ul> <li>One to two years of experience in marketing, consumer research, social media, communication skills, with a willingness to build confidence in presenting findings.</li> <li>Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and title: Manager, Analytics - Global Clients
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Manager, Analytics – Global Clients</strong></p> <p>This role is within the Data, Tech, and Analytics (DTA) team, within the Global Client Solutions organisation. The Global Client Solutions (GCS) team is responsible for all global clients within WPP. DTA is responsible for servicing clients with best-in-class data solutions, data strategy, analytics, technology and AI solutions to drive client growth. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection.</p> <p><strong>Who We Are Looking For</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an Analytics Manager to join our growing Analytics & Data Science team, reporting into the Data Tech and Analytics global lead. The team focuses on media effectiveness measurement, campaign analysis and client communication to help make brands become more valuable to the world.<br><br>You will be working with a leading advertiser, JLR, to harness their data and improve the performance of their campaigns, developing and deploying media measurement solutions. Communication with client stakeholders and effective management of assigned tasks is critical in this role. You will be joining an award winning team, with more than 16 tech and media industry awards to our name, including Campaign Magazine's Tech Awards Agency of the Year, Best Use of AI, and Breakthrough Tech as Part of a Campaign awards.<br><br>We have invested in giving you the tools to make you as successful as possible, including training/development, full access to Google Cloud Platform and a wider global community of analysts and data scientists.<br><br><strong>Some of the things we'd like you to do</strong><br><br></p> <p><strong>Strategic Analytics Application:</strong> Build and apply a deep understanding of marketing objectives to support Account teams with comprehensive measurement and testing plans. To help deliver "best in class" analytical capabilities across the agency with the wider Analytics team, including the use of new methods, techniques, tools and systems. Managing the process through to delivery and taking ownership of global roll out.</p> <p><strong>Marketing & Business Effectiveness: </strong>Lead the creation of clear, robust and thought-provoking campaign reviews and insights, and show the wider team/clients how to improve effectiveness. Deliver insightful campaign reviews with actionable recommendations to improve marketing effectiveness.</p> <p><strong>Measurement frameworks & Experimentation:</strong> Develop deep understanding of marketing platform testing and targeting abilities, and act in a consultative capacity in their implementation. Provide actionable insights and design experiments to optimise campaign performance - focusing on brand and conversion lift studies.</p> <p><strong>Client Stakeholder Engagement:</strong> Build trusted relationships with client’s marketing, analytics, and data leads, acting as a knowledgeable and credible day-to-day strategic partner.</p> <p><strong>Internal Stakeholder Engagement:</strong> Manage relationships with data engineering teams and set automation strategies to integrate new tools and solutions.</p> <p><strong>Commercial Contribution:</strong> Support the commercial health of your client account by contributing to the scoping and delivery of high-value analytics projects. Participate in new business pitches, helping to develop data and tech solutions that demonstrate the value of WPP Media’s capabilities. Coordinate with third-party vendors for the assessment and management of bespoke measurement solutions, including contracts and SOWs.</p> <p><strong>Thought Leaderhsip:</strong> Translate complex data concepts for stakeholders and contribute to the company's data strategy, promoting data-driven innovation within the media industry.</p> <p><strong>Skills & Qualifications</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It's what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media's shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>You will be highly numerate: able to confidently interpret data and apply statistical tests to draw robust conclusions. Holding a degree(s) in a quantitative field: Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Physical Science or Computer Science</li> <li>Experience in analytics, measurement, data science, or a related field</li> <li>Knowledge of applying measurement to media campaigns through Meta/Google, through brand and conversion lift studies, matched market tests or otherwise</li> <li>Well-developed problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively</li> <li>Strong understanding of statistics including hypothesis testing, descriptive statistics and distribution theory</li> <li>Strong communication skills, with the ability to present complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>Able to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team, using project management tools such as Jira/Trello. Ability to project manage analytics projects.</li> <li>Highly capable at presenting data in a visually engaging and insightful manner that cuts through the noise</li> <li>Experience in mentorship and management, ability to display empathy in difficult situations and lead by example</li> <li>Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and advancements in data science and analytics</li> <li>Proficiency in SQL & R/Python, including understanding of packages such as pandas, numpy, scipy & matplotlib.</li> <li>Strong understanding of what data points can be collected and analysed in a digital campaign, and how each data point should be analysed. Including knowledge of media data and incremental measurement, including both Direct Response and Brand campaigns</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of advanced measurement tools including MMM, MTA, Sales Lift, and Brand Studies.</li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="auto">#LI-Promoted</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.</li> <li>Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.</li> <li>Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.</li> <li><strong>Developer-Architect Mindset</strong><strong>:</strong> A hands-on builder who sets reference architectures and patterns, leading by example through direct code contributions and rigorous code/IaC reviews.</li> <li><strong>70/30 Design-to-Advise Split: </strong>Spends 70–80% of the time architecting solutions, writing code, packaging repeatable patterns and prototyping new concepts, drawing on end-to-end understanding of the data platform in use, and 20–30% in front of clients, translating commercial objectives into technical roadmaps and explaining trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders in their own language.</li> <li><strong>Coding & Automation Obsession</strong><strong>:</strong> Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, SQL, Terraform); title: Associate Director, Activation & Delivery, GCS
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.</p> <p>WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Search & Ecommerce Account Director to lead the strategic development, execution, and performance of integrated biddable activity across <strong>Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max)</strong> and <strong>Amazon Search</strong>.</p> <p>As a senior leader within the team, you will be responsible for <strong>defining and delivering best-in-class search and ecommerce strategies</strong>, ensuring alignment with broader client business goals and full-funnel media objectives.</p> <p>You will act as the <strong>senior client contact</strong>, working with stakeholders at Director level and above, while leading cross-functional teams and offshore delivery hubs to execute against strategy.</p> <p>This role combines <strong>deep platform expertise, strategic leadership, and operational oversight</strong>, ensuring campaigns are executed to the highest standard while continuously driving innovation and growth.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities: </strong></p> <p><strong>Strategic Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the development of holistic Search & Ecommerce strategies across: <ul> <li>Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max)</li> <li>Amazon Search (Sponsored Ads ecosystem)</li> </ul> </li> <li>Ensure strategies are aligned to client business objectives, KPIs, and commercial priorities</li> <li>Translate broader marketing strategy into channel-specific activation frameworks</li> <li>Identify growth opportunities across demand capture (Search) and retail media (Amazon)</li> <li>Drive integration between Search, Ecommerce, and wider media channels (Paid Social, Programmatic, SEO)</li> <li>Develop forward-thinking POVs on industry trends, platform developments, and emerging opportunities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client and Stakeholder Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary senior contact for Search & Ecommerce across your client portfolio</li> <li>Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, becoming a trusted strategic advisor</li> <li>Lead client meetings, presentations, quarterly reviews, and strategic planning sessions</li> <li>Clearly articulate performance, insights, and forward strategy</li> <li>Identify opportunities to grow client investment and expand scope</li> </ul> <p><strong> Performance and Campaign</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain ultimate accountability for performance delivery across all Search & Ecommerce activity</li> <li>Oversee campaign execution across Google Ads and Amazon platforms, ensuring alignment with strategy <ul> <li>Ensure robust optimisation frameworks are in place across:</li> <li>Bidding & automation (e.g., Smart Bidding, PMAX optimisation)</li> <li>Feed optimisation (Shopping / Amazon)</li> <li>Query, audience, and keyword strategies</li> </ul> </li> <li>Lead performance reviews, identifying risks and opportunities</li> <li>Ensure rigorous testing frameworks are defined and executed</li> <li>Ensure all campaigns are delivered <strong>on time, within budget, and to the highest standards</strong></li> <li>Maintain strong governance across: <ul> <li>QA processes</li> <li>Financial management and invoicing</li> <li>Platform best practice adherence</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive improvements in workflows, automation, and efficiency</li> <li>Ensure clear documentation of processes and ways of working</li> <li>Lead development of <strong>test & learn roadmaps</strong> across Search and Ecommerce</li> <li>Identify opportunities to leverage new platform capabilities (e.g., PMAX, AI bidding, Amazon innovations)</li> <li>Contribute to agency thought leadership, case studies, and award submissions</li> <li>Actively participate in the wider Search and Commerce communities within WPP Media</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Onshore–Offshore Delivery Model</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and manage ways of working between onshore strategy teams and offshore execution teams</li> <li>Ensure offshore teams are set up for success with: <ul> <li>Clear briefs</li> <li>Defined processes</li> <li>QA frameworks and performance standards</li> </ul> </li> <li>Oversee output quality across offshore Account Managers and Executives</li> <li>Drive scalability, efficiency, and operational excellence across delivery</li> <li>Lead and develop a team of Account Managers and Account Executives (onshore and offshore)</li> <li>Provide coaching, mentorship, and performance management</li> <li>Ensure effective workload allocation, prioritisation, and delivery</li> <li>Support hiring and team growth aligned to client needs</li> <li>Foster a high-performing, collaborative, and innovative team culture</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong> Skills & Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience across: <ul> <li>Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max)</li> <li>Amazon Search / Retail Media ecosystems</li> </ul> </li> <li>Proven track record of leading performance-driven search and ecommerce strategies</li> <li>Strong understanding of full-funnel media strategy and cross-channel integration</li> <li>Advanced analytical skills with ability to translate data into actionable insights</li> <li>Experience managing large-scale, complex accounts and budgets</li> <li>Strong client leadership experience, including senior stakeholder management</li> <li>Experience managing and developing multi-layered teams (including offshore models)</li> <li>Deep understanding of bidding strategies, feed-based media, automation, and measurement</li> <li>Strong communication and presentation skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</p> <p> </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</p> <p> </p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p> </p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p> </p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You would have excellent oral and written communication skills, be client obsessed, self-motivated and able to operate both as a team and independently with limited guidance and direction</p> <p>The Manager, Client Analytics is following the direction of Director of Analytics and is responsible for data manipulation and visualization, performing quantitative data analysis, problem solving, statistical modeling, and developing/analysing business cases.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Apply deep knowledge of basic statistics (significance testing, correlation analysis, confidence intervals, descriptive statistics) to support analytical solutions.</li> <li>Use statistical modeling techniques (regression, classification) to extract business value from campaign data.</li> <li>Utilize programming languages (Python, R, SQL), statistical packages (SciPy), and Google tools (BigQuery, Tensorflow, Datalab) to prototype and deliver data-driven solutions.</li> <li>Recommend and develop technical solutions with guidance from senior leadership.</li> <li>Define project scope, setup, and effort estimation in collaboration with the account Analytics lead.</li> <li>Build and maintain strong relationships with Analytics leads and gain a deep understanding of client challenges.</li> <li>Work closely with key stakeholders to assess project needs and ensure delivery of best-in-class analytics work.</li> <li>Collaborate with regional leadership on process development, improvement, and compliance.</li> <li>Support campaign measurement, determine incremental lift from marketing activities, and manage reporting and data needs (ingestion, cleaning, delivery).</li> <li>Code in SQL and Python to create reports and build dashboards; prior experience in digital agency or consulting preferred.</li> <li>Proficient coding skills in statistical software (R, Python, SciPy), programming languages (SQL, Python), and MS Office tools (especially advanced Excel/Google Sheets).</li> <li>Experience in owning and delivering analytics projects, including correlation, regression, significance testing, A/B tests, and supervised machine learning.</li> <li>Practical understanding of data science techniques, statistical analysis, and modeling.</li> <li>Passion for data analysis, troubleshooting data anomalies, integrating data from multiple sources to create repositories for data science models.</li> <li>Ability to transform raw data into actionable business insights for decision-making and strategic planning.</li> <li>Strong logical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills.</li> <li>Adherence to quality standards and ability to plan and prioritize work.</li> <li>Experience using or building reports with business intelligence tools is a plus.</li> <li>Experience in applying big data, statistics, and analytical techniques to solve client problems is preferred.</li> <li>Business acumen to provide actionable strategic recommendations is preferred</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong> </p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. title: Mid Market Account Executive - DACH
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €<strong>10k to </strong><strong>€</strong><strong>300k</strong>, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.</p> <p>Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).</p> <p>You should apply if: </p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world</strong>: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting</strong>: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.</li> <li><strong>You have innate curiosity in how businesses work</strong>: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You are a life-long learner</strong>: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.</li> <li><strong>You build genuine relationships with your customers</strong>: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. The window to build something significant is open right now. </li> <li><strong>Sharpen Your Edge:</strong> Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>Minimum Requirements for the role:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Winning DNA:</strong> Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.</li> <li><strong>Over-achievement:</strong> A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment</li> <li><strong>Strategic Grit:</strong> Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt</li> <li><strong>Native German</strong> language speakers</li> </ul> <p>Advantageous:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Intellectual Curiosity:</strong> You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.</li> <li><strong>A Repeatable Sales Framework:</strong> You don’t rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.</li> <li><strong>A Data-Minded Approach:</strong> You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Continuous Process Iteration:</strong> You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. title: Deployed Engineer
description: Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with. More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com , Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI . The role Deployment Engineers own the technical side of getting Wordsmith live inside a customer. Once a deal is signed, you’ll connect Wordsmith to the systems our customers already run on. That means identity and SSO, Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Google Workspace, Salesforce, document management, chat tools, and MCP connections to the wider AI and data stack. You’ll design how data and permissions flow between them, build and test the integrations, and work through each customer’s IT and security requirements until everything works in production. It’s part integration engineering, part solutions architecture, and part customer-facing problem solving. You’ll be the technical lead on every deployment you own, the person customer IT teams talk to, and the person who works out how to make it work when an integration doesn’t behave as documented. This is a technical, hands-on role. You don’t need to be a lawyer, and we’re not necessarily looking for one. We’re looking for engineers and technical consultants who understand identity, APIs and enterprise SaaS, and who enjoy making systems talk to each other. Your focus is the technical foundation the rest of the deployment runs on. You’ll work side by side with our Legal Engineers on every deployment. While you connect Wordsmith to the customer’s systems, they configure the platform itself: workflows, agents, playbooks and automations built around how the legal team works. You’ll plan the deployment together, agree what each integration needs to support, and make sure the connections you build give their configuration the data, documents and permissions it depends on. What you’ll do 1. Integrations Own the integrations for each deployment, including SSO and SCIM, Microsoft 365, SharePoint and OneDrive, Google Workspace, Salesforce, document management and chat tools Configure and connect Wordsmith to customers’ wider AI and data stack through MCP Build, test and harden integrations so they hold up in production, not just in a demo 2. Identity, Security & Access Set up identity and access, including SSO with Okta, Entra ID and Google, user provisioning, roles and permissions Work through customers’ security reviews, IT questionnaires and data-handling requirements Make sure permissions in Wordsmith respect the permissions in the systems it connects to 3. Technical Solution Design Take the technical handover from Sales and confirm the customer’s systems landscape, constraints and integration scope Design how data, documents and requests flow between Wordsmith and the customer’s tools Advise customer IT on the right architecture for their environment and where the trade-offs sit Work with Legal Engineers to agree what each integration needs to support the workflows, agents and playbooks they’re configuring 4. Technical Delivery & Escalation Lead the technical workstream of each deployment, from environment setup and integration build through testing to go-live Diagnose and fix integration issues, and act as the escalation point for technical problems during rollout Know when a problem needs Engineering, and bring them a clear, reproducible case 5. Improve How We Integrate Turn what you learn into reusable integration patterns, setup guides and technical runbooks Feed connector gaps, API limitations and recurring requests back to Product and Engineering What we’re looking for Hands-on experience deploying and integrating enterprise SaaS in customer environments Strong working knowledge of identity and access, including SSO (SAML, OIDC), SCIM provisioning, Okta, Entra ID or Google Workspace Experience integrating with the Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Google Workspace or Salesforce ecosystems Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, authentication flows and reading technical documentation. You can script or write code where it helps Familiarity with MCP or other ways of connecting AI systems to tools and data, or a strong appetite to learn Credible with customer IT and security teams. You can answer their questions and stand behind your architecture Methodical troubleshooter who isolates problems, reproduces them and fixes them Clear communicator who can explain a technical decision to a non-technical stakeholder Typical backgrounds include Deployment, integration or implementation engineers in SaaS Solutions engineers or solutions architects Technical consultants with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace or Salesforce experience IT or identity engineers who have moved into customer-facing roles How we work We’re an in-person team based in Edinburgh or London. You should expect to work from the office or visit customers as your default. We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. There will not always be an established playbook, so you’ll need to bring curiosity, structure and persistence to unfamiliar situations. You’ll sit in the Transformation team, reporting to the VP of Transformation, and work closely with our Legal Engineers, alongside Legal Intelligence, Enablement, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product. Our customer teams have clear but closely connected responsibilities: Transformation leads implementation, Support Engineering resolves technical issues, Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth, Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation, and Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability. Why Wordsmith Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding within larger organisations. Wordsmith is only as useful as the systems it connects to. Every new customer brings a different stack, and Deployment Engineers are the people who make Wordsmith work inside it. You’ll work directly with ambitious in-house legal teams, see how dozens of legal functions really operate, and take that back into a product you help shape. You will work across enterprise identity, productivity and CRM platforms, and on MCP as it develops into a standard. You will own real technical outcomes from your first week and help define how we integrate as we scale. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Our current analytics environment includes BigQuery and Looker.</li> <li value="3">The ability to move from data to an explanation: identifying patterns, investigating why they're happening and making practical recommendations.</li> <li value="3">Clear communication, including the ability to explain your own contribution to a project, your analytical approach and what changed as a result.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Next steps</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p>Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a ---------- <p> </p> <p><strong>Our hybrid approach</strong></p> <p>Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better and build a great Liberis culture. title: Demand & Campaigns Lead, EMEA
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: We're looking for an exceptional marketing leader to drive Notion’s growth across EMEA— the team responsible for both the fuel that powers our regional go-to-market and the engine that converts it into pipeline and revenue. You'll lead a multi-disciplinary group of marketers across digital, demand, content, and campaigns, and you'll own the end-to-end system that turns regional narratives into measurable growth across markets. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. to demos and sales;  to ensuring successful account switch and activation.</li> <li>Guiding customers through Monzo’s business banking offerings - providing clear, factual information and helping them evaluate what works best.</li> <li>Being a product expert: fully understand Monzo's business banking products, features and services.</li> <li>Managing a pipeline of leads with strong attention to data hygiene: timely follow-ups, accurate forecasting, deal tracking.</li> <li>Driving activation: not just closing, but ensuring new business customers are fully set up, onboarded, and are using Monzo for their banking needs.</li> <li>Collaborating internally: work closely with marketing, product, risk and customer operations to ensure a smooth journey for customers.</li> <li>Delivering outstanding service at every touchpoint: via phone, video, email or digital channels.</li> <li>Achieving sales targets: conversion, activations, revenue, engagement and other growth metrics as set by the commercial leadership.</li> <li>Feeding insights back: capture and share customer feedback — customer pain points, required features, suggestions for product improvements.</li> <li>Adapting & iterate: Things will change rapidly and often - you’ll need to be comfortable with ambiguity and change and help support what comes next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have experience in Small Business sales, ideally selling business solutions or financial services; knowing how to engage business customers and understand their mindset, needs and pain points.</li> <li>Have a proven track record of meeting (or exceeding) sales quotas / targets in a performance-driven environment.</li> <li>Are an expert at managing a full sales cycle: from prospecting to activation, including structured and rigorous outreach and follow-ups and cross-team coordination.</li> <li>Have high emotional intelligence and are able to quickly connect and build a relationship with customers of diverse backgrounds and levels of knowledge.</li> <li>Are a strategic communicator,  excellent at building trust and helping customers discover value - you’re consultative, you listen, you ask insightful questions.</li> <li>Are adaptable and resilient, you embrace change and have a strong winning mindset to see challenges as opportunities to learn and grow.</li> <li>Can communicate clearly: written, verbal, via video; you simplify complex topics for customers.</li> <li>Are coachable and comfortable seeking constructive criticism to empower continuous learning and improvement</li> <li>Are comfortable working in a fast-moving, high change environment. You thrive when things aren’t fully defined yet.</li> <li>Can demonstrate high levels of personal organisation: tracking your pipeline, managing your time, prioritising your leads and follow-up tasks.</li> <li>Have integrity and strong consumer duty awareness: regulatory compliance, knowing your customer, reducing risk, safeguarding data and ensuring we put consumer duty first are foundational to this role and our culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus / Nice-to-haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience in a regulated environment (banking)</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce</li> <li>Familiarity with SMBs in specific verticals (e.g. food & drink, professional services, construction)</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission)</p> <p>📍 4 days a week in our London office but with occasional flexibility to work remotely (in the UK)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Canonical solutions.</p> <p>Location: Office Based in London, England.</p> <h2><strong>The role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Empathetic Engagement:</strong> Partner directly with customers to deliver meaningful, outstanding results for teams or customers.</li> <li><strong>Linux & Cloud Familiarity:</strong> Practical, hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, with an exposure to Ecosystems:</em> Block, object, and network storage technologies.</li> <li><em>System Networking:</em> Navigating bonding, firewalls, bridging, switching, or MTU tuning.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Analytical Curiosity:</strong> A strong troubleshooting mindset—the ability to look into stack traces or logs, identify OS/application-level bugs, and strategically guide the customer through next steps.</li> <li><strong>Development Fundamentals:</strong> Basic programming logic in any language to help parse code and collaborate effectively with Canonical Engineering teams.</li> title: Group Financial Controller
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Group Financial Controller</strong>.</p> <p>The ideal candidate has a deep passion for systems accounting, a track record of preparing finance functions for public markets and an innovative mindset that leverages technology and AI to build efficient and robust accounting workflows.<br>The Accounting team ensures the integrity of our financial information and serves as the primary stewards of the business’ financial health. They design and operate a governance framework underpinned by robust policies, controls and systems to provide oversight and challenge to the business. The team is responsible for timely and accurate reporting and exercises judgment when necessary based on a commitment to conservative and accurate reporting, a deep understanding of accounting principles and insights into our business.</p> <p>We are looking for a professionally qualified accounting leader who has a deep sense of right and wrong, high integrity, and a strong sense of responsibility, understanding that the accuracy of their work is critical to the entire Company. </p> <p>You are a methodical, detail-oriented, and process-driven problem-solver who enjoys investigating discrepancies to find their root cause. You are resilient under pressure, particularly during month-end and year-end closes, and motivated by the goal of achieving a perfect, timely, and reliable result.</p> <p>Perhaps unusually we prefer a leader with deep personal interest in the software and technology industry, and some data analytics, AI and ideally software engineering experience.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is home-based in EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office. It will report to our Chief Financial Officer.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Ensuring strong understanding of the risks associated with our processes and systems and leading the development and implementation of controls to mitigate those risks</li> <li>Leading the development and identification of areas of improvement of Canonical’s policies and procedures that will enable the business to scale efficiently</li> <li>Driving the implementation of the Canonical’s policies and procedures and the monitoring of compliance </li> <li>Supporting multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy</li> <li>Managing reviews of weekly, month-end, year-end processes from balance sheet reconciliations to management accounts and statutory accounts preparation to ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial information</li> <li>Ensuring accuracy and completeness of the recording and reporting of financial data and transactions to ensure that the Company maintains robust accounting records</li> <li>Upholding the Company’s accounting and approval processes and controls across the organization</li> <li>Managing external audits </li> <li>Developing a strong understanding of the evolving regulatory frameworks and jurisdictions in which Canonical operates and lead the assurance of Canonical’s compliance with such regulatory requirements</li> <li>Driving projects associated with upgrading or implementing new finance systems and sensible AI adoption in the team</li> <li>Developing professional relationships and manage communications with both internal and external stakeholders - customers, vendors, tax authorities and external advisers -  including resolving questions and issues confidentially and  in a timely manner</li> <li>Managing or mentoring junior accounting staff, sharing knowledge and promoting best practices</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>A strong academic background and professional qualification in Accounting or Finance (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent)</li> <li>Extensive practical IFRS knowledge and experience</li> <li>Advanced Excel skills and strong data analysis capabilities</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced setting</li> <li>Confident communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with colleagues, management, customers, and external stakeholders</li> <li>A proactive, analytical mindset with a genuine passion for finance and a drive for continuous improvement, process efficiency and professional development</li> <li>Proven experience using enterprise-level accounting or ERP systems</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with NetSuite</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce</li> <li>Experience with a Big 4 Accounting Firm, or a Public company</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

description: <h1>Tax Senior Associate</h1> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. This role covers multiple Canonical corporate entities in several countries. We have a preference for candidates in EMEA time zones.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>astute and forward-thinking tax professional</strong> to build a tax function from the ground up at a profitable, fast-growing technology company. We're looking for someone with a keen interest in technology and how technology is changing the tax profession, who can translate that insight into a modern, effective strategy and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the CFO, you will <strong>design and own the tax processes</strong> that support our global expansion. Your primary challenge will be navigating the complexity of the evolving global environment in which we operate, where tax rules are constantly evolving. You will work with the CFO to establish a scalable and efficient framework fit for a dynamic, global software business—tackling everything from digital services taxes to leveraging new tax technologies.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and strategic thinking</strong> over years of experience. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, a professional qualification in accounting and tax and demonstrable exposure to global tax considerations in a multinational context.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><em>This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region, or may be office based in London, UK</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Manage and coordinate the preparation and review of corporate tax, VAT, and other relevant tax returns for our entities, ensuring timely and accurate filings</li> <li>Work with external advisers to develop transfer pricing documentation and tax planning initiatives and lead their implementation</li> <li>Act as a key point of contact for tax authority audits and enquiries, preparing responses and supporting documentation in collaboration with external advisors.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to streamline and improve tax processes, controls, and data management to enhance efficiency and accuracy particularly using technology and automation</li> <li>Manage and run tax provisioning and reporting under IFRS, including calculating effective tax rates and preparing tax-related disclosures for financial statements</li> <li>Work closely with the wider finance team, legal, and business operations to provide tax support and ensure cross-functional alignment</li> <li>Monitor changes in tax legislation across the regions in which we operate and assess their potential impact on the company.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in business, finance, economics, technology or other quantitative field</li> <li>Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA) and tax advisor (CTA, ADIT or equivalent)</li> <li>A minimum of 3-5 years of relevant tax experience, gained within a Big 4/Top 10 accounting firm or a multinational in-house tax team.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results</li> <li>The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li> Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex tax concepts to non-tax stakeholders</li> <li>Thoughtfulness and self-motivation</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leadership ability</li> <li>Software or tech industry experience</li> <li>Public company finance and reporting experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems - title: Product Marketing Manager
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to help shape how Linear’s products are brought to market and understood by customers. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Design, CX, Sales, and Marketing, and is responsible for turning technically sophisticated product work into clear narratives, strong launches, and high-quality customer-facing experiences. You’ll go deep on the product, define positioning and messaging, and drive execution across the surfaces that matter most—from in-product copy and changelogs to enablement, documentation inputs, email, and launch communications. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines product judgment, excellent writing, and strong cross-functional leadership. Location & work mode Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America and the United Kingdom. You can work from anywhere within these regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. What you’ll do - Develop positioning, messaging, and core narratives for feature releases, key launches, and strategic product narratives - Partner closely with Product management, Engineering, and Design to refine how products are presented across in-product and external surfaces - Create and coordinate launch deliverables such as changelogs, demos, enablement materials, email, social copy, and go-to-market communications - Equip Sales, CX, and other customer-facing teams with the context and materials they need to communicate new launches effectively - Bring customer insight, product understanding, and market context back into product and launch decisions What we’re looking for - Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, with the ability to make complex ideas feel clear and compelling - Strong positioning and messaging skills grounded in customer problems, product truth, and differentiation - Great project management skills and ability to track large amounts of detail. - Comfort going deep on product details and building credibility with Product, Engineering, and Design - Strong judgment, ownership, and the ability to operate autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar What we offer We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect: - Competitive salary and equity - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday - Paid co-working space or desk - Health coverage (based on country requirements) - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays - 4 months paid parental leave - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter - Regular team events and off-sites - Remote-first with no required commute Compensation For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $145,000—$192,500. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.
